According to their calculations, they saved around one million rubles. This kind of efficiency and cost reduction can be game-changing for businesses looking to scale up quickly without breaking the bank on content creation and SEO services. How It Works Setting up “Статейник” is straightforward: you provide instructions and prompts in Russian for all 16 stages of the process, and the AI takes care of everything else. However, you need a website where the articles can be published, and you have to subscribe to Claude or Codex. The tool’s dashboard allows users to set up tasks, monitor progress, and adjust parameters as needed. You can also manage the publication of generated content on your own websites, ensuring full control over your digital presence. What Is Stored When you use “Статейник,” your input includes instructions and prompts in Russian for all 16 stages of content creation. The tool stores these inputs along with any generated content on its servers. It also tracks the performance metrics of each article, such as traffic and engagement data from Yandex and Google. This tracking helps users understand which types of articles are performing well and adjust their strategies accordingly. However, it’s important to note that this data is used solely for improving the AI's performance and does not include any personal information beyond what is necessary for content generation. Additionally, the effectiveness of “Статейник” depends heavily on the quality of prompts provided by users. The AI’s success is also contingent on how well it understands and executes your specific instructions. You can build a personal brand around templates, and having an audience is obviously valuable, but templates dont naturally lend themselves to building a distribution channel in the same a newsletter, SaaS, or content business does. There’s also the difference between having an audience and having high-intent distribution. That’s why I dont think an owned distribution can replace marketplace distribution. And that’s not unique to Framer either. The same thing happened to Notion templates, Webflow templates, UI kits, coding boilerplates, and other marketplace-driven products. Yeah creators can diversify, build an audience, etc. but marketplace was part of the business model, and when that changes, the economics change with it.

text: 𝗔 𝗗𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗟𝗢𝗣𝗘𝗥 𝗕𝗨𝗜𝗟𝗗𝗦 𝗢𝗡 𝗝𝗨𝗦𝗧𝗟𝗘𝗡𝗗 𝗗𝗔𝗢 𝗔𝗣𝗜𝗦 𝗗𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗟𝗢𝗣𝗘𝗥 𝗡𝗘𝗘𝗗 A developer building a wallet, a portfolio dashboard or a liquidation monitor on TRON wants live lending data: market rates, account positions, staking state and energy rental orders. They want it structured, typed and reliable enough to put in front of users. 𝗟𝗜𝗠𝗜𝗧𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 Reading everything directly from contracts is slow and repetitive, and history is harder still. The API returns current state, and there is no official hosted indexer for historical events such as Mint, Borrow, RepayBorrow or LiquidateBorrow. Anyone who wants a full history has to plan for it, whether by filtering events through TronGrid, which retains roughly 30 days, or by running their own indexer against an archive node. 𝗜𝗡𝗙𝗥𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗨𝗖𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘 JustLend DAO fills the gap with a public HTTP API described by an OpenAPI 3.1 specification, so it can be imported into Swagger, Postman or an LLM tool. Endpoints cover all markets, per address positions, sTRX and Energy Rental dashboards, V2 vaults, V2 markets and aggregated V2 portfolios, and even a list of accounts above the liquidation observation threshold. Contract addresses for Mainnet and Nile ship as machine readable files, and JSON ABI files carry the canonical event signatures. 𝗜𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗚𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 The developer calls the markets endpoint for supply and borrow APY, TVL and prices, and the account endpoint for positions and health. Numbers arrive as strings, so a big decimal library keeps precision on large values. Errors come back inside the response body with an HTTP 200 status, so the code branches on the body's code field. For heavier reads, the MCP server batches account queries through Multicall3, cutting them from around 8 seconds to around 2.5. 𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗟𝗜𝗖𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 The result is a dashboard that shows a wallet's supply, borrow and staking positions together, or a monitor that watches the high risk account list and alerts liquidators when positions cross the threshold. The same building blocks work for a wallet that wants to show yields before a user deposits. 𝗨𝗦𝗘𝗥 𝗔𝗖𝗧𝗜𝗩𝗜𝗧𝗬 The end user sees rates, health and balances in an interface they already use, without knowing which endpoint served them. They supply, borrow, stake and rent Energy with current information, and liquidators find eligible positions faster, which keeps the lending pool healthy for everyone. That is JustLend DAO's contribution to TRON's developer side: the protocol is not only usable through its own app but reachable through published, typed and candid interfaces that state their own limits. Each new application built on those interfaces extends the protocol's reach, and the developers still to arrive will find the same clear starting point. @justinsuntron @DeFi_JUST #TRONEcoStar

It sounds like a product feature, but it is really a question of trust across organizations: how does a stranger's software know that this agent is what it says it is? 𝗟𝗜𝗠𝗜𝗧𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 Without a shared standard, discovery and interaction depend on trust that has been arranged in advance, and payments usually depend on a third party. Each new counterpart means a new agreement, which does not fit software that operates around the clock. 𝗜𝗡𝗙𝗥𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗨𝗖𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘 The missing piece is the 8004 protocol, which assigns each AI agent a tamper proof onchain digital ID. That ID records the agent's capability claims, its payment wallet address, its historical reputation and third party verifications, all transparently and immutably. AINFT has released the official SDK for the 8004 protocol, and it supports deployment on BNB Chain and TRON. 𝗜𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗚𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 Integration is short. The developer sets the network parameters and the private key for the target chain, TRON or BNB Chain, and initialization is done. If x402 is added, the developer can enable payment functionality and set wallet permissions. 𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗟𝗜𝗖𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 The result is an agent that can receive onchain payments and streaming payments natively, without relying on a third party. It is discoverable through its identity and payable through its wallet. 𝗨𝗦𝗘𝗥 𝗔𝗖𝗧𝗜𝗩𝗜𝗧𝗬 Other agents and users can now find the agent, review its record and reputation, and pay it for work as it is delivered. The agent's history accumulates with every interaction, so the identity becomes more valuable with use. AINFT's own summary is memorable: x402 gave AI agents the hands to pay, and 8004 equips those hands with a verifiable ID and a traceable credit history. For TRON, this means developers can build agents that act as accountable participants in the network's economy, using the chain as the place where identity, payment and reputation meet. The SDK is only the first step, and TRON's developers will decide how far it goes. @justinsuntron @AINFTcom #TRONEcoStar
